UI_GOOGLE_DELIVERY_STATUS_2:
Google Play did not deliver this specific version. Common causes:
• The selected version is no longer in Google's active catalog
  (Google removes old versions and only offers the current release plan).
• The account does not own Minecraft Bedrock.

Solutions:
1. Check 'Latest version (auto)' and retry.
2. Verify ownership at:
   https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mojang.minecraftpe
3. Use the 'Local APK' tab to install an APK you already have.
